guides.title: Make clips from a YouTube, Twitch or Kick link
guides.answer: Copy the link to a stream or video, paste it on Home and tap **Make clips**. Clip Factory finds the best moments for you.
steps: Copy the link from YouTube, Twitch or Kick.
Watch it work in **Jobs**. New clips wait for you in **Review**.

guides.title: Make clips from your own video file
guides.answer: You can make clips from a video file too. Tap **Pick a video** on Home, choose the file and tap **Make clips**. On a computer you can also drag the video onto the box.
steps: Tap the box and pick an MP4, MOV or WebM file (up to 5 GB). On a computer you can also drag the video from your folder and drop it on the box.

guides.title: Where is my job and how long does it take
guides.answer: Every link or video you add is one job. **Jobs** shows each one being made, step by step.
steps: Tap a job to watch its steps.
To stop it, tap **Stop job**. Clips already made are kept.

guides.title: My job failed
guides.answer: When a job fails, open it and tap **Try again**. It starts over from the beginning and uses the video it already saved.

guides.title: Is anything running right now
guides.answer: **Jobs** shows what Clip Factory is making right now.
steps: Tap **Jobs** to see each job and how far along it is.

guides.title: What Keep does
guides.answer: **Keep** says yes to a clip. It goes in line to be posted to the places you picked. Nothing is posted until you tap **Keep**.
steps: Tap **Keep** to post it, or **Throw away** if you do not like it.

guides.title: Throw away a clip, and Undo
guides.answer: Tap **Throw away** on a clip you do not want. Changed your mind? Tap **Undo** within 8 seconds and it comes back.
steps: Oops? Tap **Undo** on the message at the bottom, within 8 seconds.

guides.title: Change a caption before Keep
guides.answer: Each clip has its own caption for every place it posts. Change them on the clip in **Review** before you tap **Keep**. They save by themselves.
steps: Under the clip, tap the place, like **TikTok**.

guides.title: How many clips are waiting in Review
guides.answer: New clips wait in **Review** until you **Keep** or **Throw away** each one.
steps: Tap **Review** to check them one by one.

guides.title: Posting a kept clip failed
guides.answer: If posting a kept clip fails, its page says so. Go to **Review** and tap **Try again** on that clip.
steps: Find the clip that says it did not finish.

guides.title: See how a clip is doing
guides.answer: Open a clip in **Library** to see its views, likes and comments on each place it was posted. A crown marks where it did best.
steps: Scroll to see each place and its numbers.

guides.title: How much money did I make?
guides.answer: Clip Factory only shows money an app reports. It never guesses from views and you never type money in. Tap **Money** in the menu. The big number at the top is what the apps reported for your last 30 days. The list under it shows each posted clip with what YouTube says it earned, the biggest first. TikTok, Instagram and X don't share money with apps.
steps: Read the big number at the top. Each amount says whose estimate it is.
Scroll down to see what each clip earned.
keywords: how much money did i make

guides.title: What is MRR on the Money page?
guides.answer: MRR usually means subscriptions. Here it means the money the apps reported for your videos: **Monthly MRR** is the last 30 days, **Weekly MRR** the last 7, **Daily MRR** a normal day lately and **Yearly MRR** the monthly money kept up for a year (**at this pace**). Pick apps with the icons at the bottom right.
steps: Tap app icons in the bar at the bottom right to pick apps. **All** shows every app.
Tap **7 days**, **30 days**, **90 days** or **Year** to change the chart and the clip list.

guides.title: Am I monetized yet?
guides.answer: Open **Settings › Posting › Money**. Each app's card has a pill: **Earning**, **In the program**, **Not yet**, **Goal reached**, **Can't tell** or **Not shared**, and bars like 812 / 1,000 subscribers. Only YouTube tells apps if you're in its paid program. **Goal reached** means you hit the numbers, but the app also checks things Clip Factory can't see.
steps: Look at each app's pill and bars.
Tap **More** to see the other goals.

guides.title: Let Clip Factory read your YouTube money
guides.answer: On the YouTube card, press **Allow money reading** and say yes on Google's page. A grown-up first adds the money permission in the same Google Cloud project (no new keys) and sets Publishing status to **In production**. Google's "unverified app" screen is normal: press **Advanced**, then **Continue**. Your connection and posts stay as they are.
steps: On the YouTube card, tap **First time? Steps for a grown-up** and do the steps.

guides.title: Where do I add my bank account to get paid?
guides.where: Settings › Posting › Money › Getting your money out
guides.answer: Each app pays you itself, so you add your bank account or PayPal inside each app. YouTube: **AdSense for YouTube › Payments**. Facebook and Instagram: Meta's payout settings. TikTok: your TikTok **Balance**. X: **Monetization**, through Stripe. Clip Factory never needs your bank details, and never asks for them.
steps: Open that app and add your bank or PayPal there.

guides.title: How many views does this clip have
guides.answer: A clip's page in **Library** adds up its views from every place it was posted.
steps: Tap the clip to see its views.

live.text: This clip has {value} views so far. It does best on {platform}.

guides.title: How many clips have I posted
guides.answer: **Library** lists every clip you kept and posted.

guides.title: Refresh numbers
guides.answer: Numbers update by themselves. To check now, open the clip and tap **Refresh numbers**. If it says **Next check in**, wait that long. Instagram and Facebook can take 2 days to settle.

guides.title: Star the best clips of the week
guides.answer: In **Library**, tap **This week** and star the clips that did best with **Best this week**. Clip Factory learns from your stars and makes more clips like them.
steps: Tap the star on your best clips (up to 10).

guides.where: Settings › Clip making › What it learned
guides.title: How Clip Factory learns from your clips
guides.answer: Every day Clip Factory checks your clips 7 days after posting. When some clips did much better than normal for that streamer, it looks at what they share and writes a short lesson. Lessons it is sure about go to your skills as **Prior learnings**. You can turn a lesson off or delete it in **What it learned**.
steps: Tap **Turn off** or **Delete** on a lesson you do not like.

guides.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow
guides.title: Follow streamers and see who is live
guides.answer: Open **Streamers I follow** and paste a streamer's link or type their name. If you type a name, tap **YouTube**, **Twitch** or **Kick**. Only follow streamers who said you can clip them: tap **Yes, they said I can**, then **Follow**. You see who is **LIVE** and when a stream ended or a new video came out. Making clips by itself comes in the next update; each video costs the same as one you paste.
steps: Paste a link or type a name, then tap **Find**.
Tap **Yes, they said I can**, then **Follow**.

guides.where: Settings › Clip making › Streamers I follow › Twitch and Kick keys
guides.title: Twitch and Kick keys for live badges
guides.answer: YouTube works without keys. To see when Twitch or Kick streamers are live, a grown-up makes a free app on dev.twitch.tv or kick.com once and pastes its two keys in **Twitch and Kick keys**. Until then the streamer shows **Needs a grown-up**, but you can still follow them. Removing keys needs a long press.
steps: Ask a grown-up to tap **I am the grown-up** and follow the steps.

guides.title: Views on my best clip this week
guides.answer: **This week** in **Library** shows this week's clips, most views first.

live.text: Your best clip this week, "{hook}", has {value} views.

guides.title: Total views this week
guides.answer: **This week** in **Library** adds up the views of this week's clips.

live.text: This week's clips have {value} views together.

guides.title: How many clips this week
guides.answer: **This week** in **Library** lists the clips from this week.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › TikTok
guides.title: Why my clip is private on TikTok
guides.answer: TikTok shows posts from Clip Factory privately until Clip Factory's TikTok app is approved. Your clip is posted, only you can see it for now, and its numbers come after.
steps: TikTok says **Posted privately**. That is normal for now.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › TikTok
guides.title: TikTok won't let me press Save
guides.answer: On TikTok's app page, **Save** stays off until **App review** has its text and a video. Copy the review text in TikTok setup step 13, add a short screen video, then Save. Display API is not a product any more: add video.list and user.info.stats with **Add scopes** under Login Kit.
steps: Copy the review text into **App review**.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › YouTube
guides.title: Connect YouTube
guides.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **YouTube**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect YouTube**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › Instagram
guides.title: Connect Instagram
guides.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **Instagram**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect Instagram**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › Facebook
guides.title: Connect Facebook
guides.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **Facebook**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect Facebook**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › TikTok
guides.title: Connect TikTok
guides.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **TikTok**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect TikTok**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › X
guides.title: Connect X
guides.answer: Open **Set up posting** and tap **X**. Follow its steps one by one: make your key, paste it, then tap **Connect X**. You do it once, then Clip Factory posts there by itself.

guides.title: Which accounts are connected
guides.answer: **Set up posting** shows how many of the five places are ready, and a card for each one.

guides.title: Where did my setup list go?
guides.answer: The **Set up posting** list sits at the top right until each place is set up or skipped. When all five are done or skipped, it says **All set!** and goes away. It comes back by itself if a place you set up needs you again. You can always find every place, skip one, or bring back one you skipped in **Settings › Posting › Set up posting**.
steps: Find the place you skipped. It says **Skipped**.
Tap **Un-skip** to put it back on the list, or tap its card to set it up now.

guides.title: Where kept clips get posted
guides.answer: In **Where clips go** you pick the places your kept clips are posted. Pick at least one.
steps: Turn each place on or off.

guides.where: Settings › Posting › Set up posting › X
guides.title: What X charges for numbers
guides.answer: X charges a little for every number check. The checks stop at $10 a month, so X never costs more.

guides.title: Add a skill
guides.answer: In Skills, tap **Write a skill** and answer three easy questions. Or tap **Upload a file** to add a SKILL.md or a .zip with one inside.
steps: Tap **Write a skill**, or **Upload a file**.

guides.title: What a skill is
guides.answer: A skill teaches Clip Factory how you like your clips. All the AI in Clip Factory uses every skill, every time. To stop using one, open it and tap **Delete**. Built-in skills stay.
steps: Tap a skill to read it, edit it or delete it.

live.text: Skills Clip Factory uses right now: {value}.

guides.where: Settings › Clip making › Skills › Write a skill
guides.title: Make your own skill
guides.answer: Tap **Write a skill**. Answer the three questions: a name, when to use it, and what Clip Factory should do. Tap **Use the example** if you are stuck. Then tap **Save skill**.

guides.title: Edit a skill
guides.answer: Open **Skills** and tap the skill. Tap **Edit**, change the words, then tap **Save changes**. Built-in skills can be read, not changed.

guides.title: Delete a skill
guides.answer: To throw away a skill, open **Skills** and tap the skill. Tap **Delete**, then **Delete** again. Changed your mind? Tap **Undo** at the bottom. Built-in skills cannot be deleted.

guides.title: Change the click sound
guides.answer: Pick your **Click sound** in Settings › Look & feel › Sounds. There are 30 to choose from. Tap a card to hear it.
steps: Under **Click sound**, tap a card to hear it and pick it.

guides.title: Change the error sound
guides.answer: Pick your **Error sound** in Settings › Look & feel › Sounds. There are 30 to choose from. Tap a card to hear it.
steps: Under **Error sound**, tap a card to hear it and pick it.

guides.title: Turn sounds off or on
guides.answer: Use the **Sounds** switch in Settings › Look & feel › Sounds to turn every sound off or on.

guides.title: Make it calmer: Reduce motion and Background
guides.answer: Turn on **Reduce motion** to stop confetti, page moves and the moving background. In **Background** you can pick plain **Colours** instead of the glass or a picture.

guides.title: See through the app, or pick a picture or colours
guides.answer: In **Background** pick **See-through**, **Picture** or **Colours**. See-through lets what is behind the window peek through the glass in the Mac and Windows app. Browsers and phones can't look behind the app, so there you get the Clip Factory colours.

guides.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
guides.title: Get the app for your computer
guides.answer: You can put Clip Factory on your computer like any other app. Open **Get the app** and tap the download button for your computer.
steps: Tap **Download for Mac** or **Download for Windows**.
If your Mac says it can't open it: System Settings, Privacy & Security, Open Anyway.

guides.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
guides.title: Add Clip Factory to your iPhone Home Screen
guides.answer: On iPhone and iPad, Clip Factory goes on your Home Screen from Safari.

guides.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
guides.title: Install Clip Factory on Android
guides.answer: On Android, your browser can install Clip Factory like any other app.
steps: Tap **Install app**. Some phones say **Add to Home screen**.

guides.title: Update the app
guides.answer: New versions arrive by themselves. When one is ready, a bar at the bottom says **New version ready**. Tap **Reload**.
steps: Wait for the **New version ready** bar, then tap **Reload**.
To look right now: tap **Settings**, **App & account**, **Updates**.

guides.title: When YouTube blocks a video
guides.answer: Sometimes YouTube blocks a video and asks to sign in. Then add your **YouTube cookies** in YouTube help and tap **Try again** on the job. You can skip this until it happens.
steps: Tap **Add cookies.txt** and pick the file.
Go to **Jobs** and tap **Try again** on the blocked job.

guides.title: How many clips each time, and the longest video
guides.answer: In **Clips** you set the fewest and most clips Clip Factory makes each time, and the **Longest video** it uses.
steps: Change **How many clips** with the buttons.

guides.title: Sign out
guides.answer: Tap **Sign out** in Settings › App & account › Account.

guides.title: Show Ask a picture
guides.answer: Ask can look at a picture of your screen. Take a screenshot, then paste it in Ask or drop it on Ask.
steps: Press **Cmd+Ctrl+Shift+4** and drag over the part of the screen you want.
Or drag a picture onto **Ask**, or tap **Add a picture**.

guides.title: Show Ask a picture
guides.answer: Ask can look at a picture of your screen. Take a screenshot, then paste it in Ask.
steps: Press **Win+Shift+S** and drag over the part of the screen you want.
Or drag a picture onto **Ask**, or tap **Add a picture**.

guides.title: Show Ask a picture
guides.answer: Ask can look at a picture of your screen, or a photo.
steps: Press the side button and the volume up button together to take a screenshot.
Pick your screenshot, or take a photo.

guides.title: What Clip Factory is
guides.answer: Clip Factory turns your long streams and videos into short clips. You check each clip, tap **Keep**, and it posts them for you.
steps: Paste a link on **Home** and tap **Make clips**.

guides.title: Find my clips and videos in Library
guides.answer: Every clip you kept is in **Library**. New clips you have not checked yet wait in **Review**.
steps: Tap a clip to see how it does.

guides.where: Settings › App & account › Get the app
guides.title: Get the app on this computer
guides.answer: Your browser can put Clip Factory on this computer like any other app. Open **Get the app** and follow its steps.
steps: Follow the steps it shows for your browser.

guides.title: Turn on web search for Ask
guides.answer: Ask can read today's web pages once you add a free search key. Get it from Brave Search, paste it in **Settings › App & account › Ask** and tap **Save key**.
steps: Tap **Get a search key** and make a free account. Pick the **Search** plan.
Paste it under **Your search key** and tap **Save key**. A green check says web search is on.

guides.title: What Ask can do
guides.answer: Ask answers any question, not only about Clip Factory. It knows every page and setting, sees your own setup, can search the web and reads the files you add.
steps: Type any question, or add a file with the paperclip.
Tap the paper plane. The answer appears as it is written. Tap **Stop answer** to end it.

guides.title: Add files to Ask
guides.answer: Add files with the paperclip, drop them on Ask, or paste them. Ask reads pictures, PDFs, text files and Word, Excel and PowerPoint files. It never keeps them.
steps: Tap the paperclip, or drag files onto Ask, or paste them.
Each file shows as a tile with its kind and name.
Ask your question and tap the paper plane.

guides.title: Mark a picture in red
guides.answer: Tap a picture in Ask's tray to mark it. Draw with **Pen**, **Box** or **Arrow** in red, then tap **Save**. Ask sees exactly what you marked.
steps: Pick **Pen**, **Box** or **Arrow** and draw on what you mean.
